name: Embedded Firmware Engineering
description: Builds and verifies firmware against a hardware-constrained target — memory, timing, interrupt, and power budgets a general-purpose runtime doesn't have — the discipline generic software-construction doesn't cover.

checklists.name: Embedded Firmware Engineering Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist before firmware is accepted for integration.

items.statement: Firmware has been verified against the real target hardware, or a simulator faithful enough to substitute for it — not just compiled successfully.
Timing, memory, and power budgets declared in the Hardware Interface Specification are met, not just planned for.
The Hardware Compatibility Report identifies every target hardware revision the firmware was actually verified against.

reviewGates.name: Firmware Hardware Compatibility Review
reviewGates.statement: The Hardware Compatibility Report has been reviewed and the firmware is accepted for integration.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the verification evidence show this firmware behaves correctly on the real target hardware, within its declared constraints?
